items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I love Pops. ... Pops couldn't wait to get to Chicago and when he got to Chicago, he found people playing their ass off. He went in there and upset the world.

ctx.x: He followed Louis. He was really out there. You know what he could do? He could play-- he had this big saw, and he took a mallet from a vibraphone and he could play sort of like (imitates long sounding metallic notes). Oh man…
